title: Who will officially lead Venezuela at the end of 2026?
settlement: Resolves based on who officially holds the position of head of state of Venezuela on Dec 31, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, determined by formal appointment/swearing-in, official government listings, or active full-authority service. As of the clarification date, Nicolás Maduro is the officeholder and Juan Guaidó is not.
